paper_title: Near-Quantum-Noise Axion Dark Matter Search at CAPP around 9.5 $μ$eV
notes: Axion haloscope search 9.39-9.51 ueV (2.27-2.30 GHz). Excluded coupling at 2.7x KSVZ level. No explicit numerical g_agamma table given; data_points are rough estimates based on KSVZ at ~9.5 ueV (KSVZ g_agamma ~ 7e-16 GeV^-1, x2.7 ~ 2e-15 GeV^-1). DM density 0.45 GeV/cm^3 assumed (100% axion DM). 90% CL.
